title: World-0 Failure Coordinate Record (v0)
description: Emitted by the ENGINE for every externally observable unsuccessful interaction. This is a COORDINATE VECTOR, never a boolean. Design rules: (1) no field records a human semantic judgement about what the organism was 'trying' to do; (2) every field is mechanically derived from physics execution; (3) novel failure is preserved as candidate evidence of frontier expansion and is never suppressed or optimized away; (4) fields sufficient to distinguish failure DISAPPEARANCE from failure METABOLIZATION are mandatory.

episode_seq.description: engine ledger event_seq; the authoritative chronological anchor

lineage_id.description: root of the organismic inheritance chain

ancestor_path_hash.description: hash of the ordered ancestor id path; makes lineage-relative analysis cheap without walking the DAG

engine_source_hash.description: build-derived identity of the running engine (see GEN-2.1 F4). Binds this coordinate to an exact instrument.

world_physics_hash.description: identity of the instruction set + channel generator distribution + cost table. MUST be inside the release identity, NOT a mutable runtime file. (Direct lesson from the WOW-0 forensic survey, where the task corpus sat outside the release allowlist and could have changed without the pin moving.)

interaction.description: What the organism was interacting with, described structurally and without semantic labels.

channel_generator_depth.description: composition depth of the hidden generating program; the world's structural difficulty axis

channel_generator_hash.description: identity of the generating program; enables exact regeneration and held-out splits

channel_origin_lineage.description: for DEPOSIT channels, the lineage that emitted it. NEVER null for DEPOSIT. (The WOW-0 survey found operator_id null throughout, which made attribution -- and therefore causal ablation -- impossible. That must not recur.)

concurrent_attach_count.description: ecological contention on this channel at this tick

resource_state.description: The organism's economic position AT failure. Required to separate 'could not' from 'could not afford'.

outcome_class.description: Top-level partition of failure. Deliberately coarse; the geometry lives in the sub-objects. THE TWO ABSTENTION CLASSES ARE LOAD-BEARING: every economic rule that removes a degenerate exploit also makes acting expensive, which selects for organisms that fail less by attempting less. If a non-attempt emitted no record, the primary observable would deform for purely economic reasons and we would misread caution as capability. We instrument the dog that did not bark.

vm_fault.description: Present iff outcome_class == VM_FAULT. These codes are intrinsic to the physics, not authored task categories -- which is what makes them an honest coordinate system.

fault_depth.description: invocation/composition depth at fault; the axis on which 'reaching deeper' becomes visible

prediction_miss.description: Present iff outcome_class == PREDICTION_MISS. Retains WHERE and HOW the model broke, not merely that it did.

correct_prefix_len.description: how far the model held before diverging; a partial-credit geometry, not a pass/fail

residual_sign_pattern.description: compact encoding of the error sign sequence; distinguishes systematic bias from noise

frontier.description: The tectonic instrument. A more capable organism may look WORSE because it reaches states where new things can fail. These flags exist so that such expansion is detectable rather than mistaken for regression.

region_id.description: discretized landscape cell: a deterministic function of (channel_class, generator_depth bucket, outcome_class, fault_code | divergence bucket). The occupancy of these cells over time IS the failure landscape.

lineage_first_encounter.description: first time THIS lineage has occupied this cell

population_first_encounter.description: first time ANY lineage in this world has occupied this cell -- candidate frontier expansion

reachability_delta.description: Set by the analysis pass, not the physics. Supports distinguishing the seven disappearance causes in the charter (solved / avoided / environment changed / niche abandoned / pressure removed / representation changed / measurement broke).

action_history_hash.description: hash of the organism's action sequence this episode; enables exact replay addressing and 'after what history' queries

replay.description: Everything needed to recompute this exact failure offline. Without this the record is an anecdote.

deposit_closure_hash.description: hash of the set of deposits legally available to this organism at this tick (the engine's knowledge-frontier query, GEN-2.1 F10). Required for epistemic-inheritance ablation: it records what the organism COULD have known -- not what it used.

$comment: NON-GOALS, stated so a future maintainer does not 'improve' this schema into uselessness: (a) there is deliberately NO aggregate score, quality rating, or 'severity' field -- aggregation destroys the geometry we are trying to measure; (b) there is NO field describing intent, strategy, or explanation; (c) no LLM or human label may populate any field; (d) records are never deleted or downsampled for being common OR for being rare.
$comment_analysis_partition: MANDATORY BEFORE ANY ANALYSIS (see design review section 8, defect D1). Every coordinate must be partitioned, and the partition frozen by content hash, into: CAPABILITY-COUPLED -- any function of the prediction residual that the capability metric also reads (prediction_miss.correct_prefix_len, first_divergence_index, residual_l1, residual_linf, residual_sign_pattern); and CAPABILITY-DISJOINT -- vm_fault.*, resource_state.*, interaction.*, the abstention classes, and frontier.*. THE CONFIRMATORY TECTONIC TEST MAY USE ONLY THE DISJOINT SET. Using coupled coordinates would make the hypothesis partly tautological: a finer-resolution readout of a quantity necessarily moves before a coarse threshold on that same quantity is crossed, so we would 'discover' that a thermometer precedes a fever. Coupled coordinates are exploratory only.
$comment_sampling: Every topology statistic computed over these records MUST be rarefied to a fixed interaction count n0 per lineage-window (design review section 8, defect D2). Interaction count is itself under selection -- a lineage approaching a transition is sampled more densely by construction -- and every named topology statistic (clustering, density, boundary movement, basin counts) is sample-size sensitive. Without rarefaction we would be measuring our own sampling rate.
